description: React component for rendering and managing a suggestion list dropdown in a chat or input interface, including height calculations, scrolling, and accessibility features.

classes.name: SuggestionList
classes.description: React component class for displaying suggestion list with dynamic height, scrolling, and result handling.

methods.name: updateMaxHeight
methods.description: Calculates and sets the maximum height of the suggestion list based on window size and input height.

methods.name: scrollToItem
methods.description: Scrolls the suggestion list to ensure the specified item is visible.

methods.name: getComputedCssProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific CSS property value for an element.

methods.name: getTransform
methods.description: Calculates CSS transform style for positioning the suggestion list.

methods.name: renderNoResults
methods.description: Renders the 'no results' message when no suggestions match.
